official: 中野区乳児等通園支援事業の設備及び運営の基準に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 一般型通園支援の設備・職員基準に特例
summary: 現在の条例は、乳児等通園支援事業の設備や運営の基準を定めています。この議案では、特例保育を行う事業所で一般型の乳児等通園支援事業を行う場合に、設備・職員基準の特例を設けます。施行日は令和8年4月1日です。
changes: 特例保育を行う事業所で一般型乳児等通園支援事業を行う場合、直前2条の規定を適用しない
利用定員が、子ども・子育て支援法に基づく確認で定める定員を指すことを明記する
一部の規定で「乳児等通園支援事業者」を「乳児等通園支援事業所」に改める
who: 特例保育を行う事業所で一般型乳児等通園支援事業を行う事業者
why: 設備及び運営に関する基準の改正に伴い、一般型の設備・職員基準の特例などを条例に定めるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Creates exceptions to facility and staffing standards for general-type attendance support
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nakano City Ordinance on Standards for Facilities and Operation of Infant and Toddler Attendance Support Services
en.summary: The current ordinance sets standards for the facilities and operation of infant and toddler attendance support services. This bill establishes exceptions to facility and staffing standards when a general-type infant and toddler attendance support service is provided at a facility that provides special-case childcare. It takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Exempts general-type infant and toddler attendance support services at special-case childcare facilities from the provisions of the immediately preceding two Articles
Clarifies that “capacity” means the capacity specified in a confirmation under the Act on Child and Childrearing Support
Replaces “infant and toddler attendance support service provider” with “infant and toddler attendance support facility” in some provisions
who: Operators providing general-type infant and toddler attendance support at facilities that provide special-case childcare
Providers whose capacity is specified in a confirmation under the Act on Child and Childrearing Support
Infant and toddler attendance support service providers and facilities referred to in some provisions
en.why: The ward says this is to set out exceptions to facility and staffing standards for general-type services in the ordinance, following amendments to the standards for facilities and operation.
